latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Academic Press Release Writing skill.

- Provides a comprehensive, five-section writing structure for academic press releases.
- Includes detailed step-by-step writing workflow, best practices, and common troubleshooting tips.
- Specifies strict formatting and content accuracy requirements, including technical, readability, and newsworthiness standards.
- Offers a complete template for section lengths, image selection, and PDF image extraction using automated scripts.
- Guides users from draft writing through output in Markdown and automated Word document creation.
